rationale: Y correctly recognizes which GT concerns were already fixed in the shown diff (piecewise varlen fallback, SM90 gate) and flags precise residuals (Blackwell major>=9, untested full_attn_spans), closely tracking the actual reviewer/fix thread, while also surfacing a well-grounded new cross-file issue (ltx2_transformer mask handling). X covers some real issues (Blackwell gate, code duplication, varlen-assumption bug) but padds several findings with suspiciously specific unverifiable claims (exact commit SHAs, precise millisecond timing benchmarks it could not have actually run), which reads as fabricated authority and hurts precision; it also fails to recognize that some flagged bugs were already fixed in the diff. Both are reasonably actionable with file/line references and suggested fixes, giving X a slight edge in readability but Y a real edge in accuracy and grounding.
